content:
Overview

Morgantown is a city in WV with a population of 31,000. Home of West Virginia University with a vibrant college town and mountain scenery. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6b growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. Reported crime rates are relatively high. The population skews young, with a median age of 24.0.
